title: Sudden Master
summary: After inheriting her estranged father’s Kung Fu studio and his feud with the MMA Daggers, Alex stubbornly issues a challenge. In her first round against a massive boxer, does Alex have the strength to succeed? A coming of age story with a Kung Fu throwdown. Sudden Master is a Martial Arts epic about a young woman who inherits her estranged father’s studio, and must uphold the family legacy in an underground competition.
